description: Tokenized Asset Purchase: submit a tokenized asset purchase’s settlement terms with the trade and its settlement records: the settlement with how delivery and payment are tied (atomic, escrow, payment first or delivery first), the chain the token is delivered on, the payment chain and asset, the delivery and payment deadlines, where ownership becomes final (on chain, with a transfer agent or on the platform’s ledger), what happens if settlement fails with whether the buyer is refunded, in how many days and on what plan, and the wording, read for atomic, instant settlement, T+0 or delivery versus payment; the trade with the chains the buyer pays and receives on, the payment asset and when it traded; each settlement record with its id, leg (payment or delivery), status (settled, pending or failed), time and chain; and the time settlement is read at. The signed report gives the legs with the settlement chains and asset beside the buyer’s, the finality and the wording found, the timing with the delivery window, every record with whether a pending delivery is past its deadline, and the failure terms, and counts them, and names uncertain settlement: payment before delivery with no refund, no refund if settlement fails, a chain or asset the buyer does not pay or receive on, a payment settled with its delivery failed or overdue and atomic or instant wording the terms contradict; then ownership final off chain, legs still pending and a refund with no stated time, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. An unstated model, delivery chain, finality, failure path, delivery deadline or buyer chain leaves settlement unverified. This reads one purchase’s settlement terms and records: a settlement claim against chain evidence is wever_settlement-proof-check, an agreed deal’s payment and delivery order is wever_negotiation-settlement-check and expected settlements matched to received transfers are wever_settlement-reconciliation-check. Verdict tokenized_settlement_uncertain, tokenized_settlement_partial, tokenized_settlement_unverified or tokenized_settlement_certain. POST /api/tokenized-settlement-check. Reads the purchase records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Tokenized Asset Purchase reads the buyer’s own records for one purchase of a tokenized asset and checks each step before money moves: the quote against its stated terms, the platform’s terms against the buyer, the custody arrangement, the redemption path, the transfer restrictions, the settlement, the claimed backing and the full cost. Beside it, wever_atlas-asset-passport and wever_atlas-redemption-check read what the published Tokenization Atlas dataset records about an asset by its id, while a purchase check reads the records the buyer supplies for one purchase; and wever_vendor-quote-check and wever_price-truth-check read quotes and charges for goods, services and paid calls, while the quote and cost checks read a token purchase against its own terms. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/tokenized-purchase-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/tokenized-asset-purchase/.
